_about: Plant space and load (register: component_space, pue, load_factor, fuel_on_site). engine.js R.plant, R.pue, R.lf, R.fuel*. 11 Nov 2026 (J.B., F11 B4): batt 2.1–3.8 m² per MW for 10–15 min (FM 5-32), scaled from 1.0–1.8 at about 5 min by the cabinet count (our arithmetic).

plant._note: m² per MW; ups, batt, hp, cdu per MW of servers; dry and chill per MW of heat (× PUE); equipment study 29 Oct 2026, range across the makers compared

lf._note: high end of the load range (J.B. 11 Nov 2026): Fan et al. 2007, one operator's clusters averaged 59.5 % of their machines' combined maximum

lfLo._note: low end of the load range (J.B. 11 Nov 2026): Uptime Global Data Center Survey 2024, p. 9: one in four data centres is typically under 40 % utilised by available UPS capacity (self-reported operator survey; no average given)

fuelLkWh._note: 11 Nov 2026 (J.B.): Rehlko KD2000, G5-626 9/23 p. 2: 528.3 L/h at 2,000 kW standby, full load (manufacturer claim; our arithmetic); was 0.263 (one Cat model)

fuelPart._note: L per kWh at % of standby load: G5-626 9/23 p. 2 (528.3, 455.9, 311.6, 181.5 L/h) ÷ kW (our arithmetic); up to 4 % more by volume with HVO/renewable diesel

genTankSep._note: CSA B139.1.0:24 Table 2 (p. 85), for engine supply tanks outdoors at grade (B139.1.1 6.5.2): [largest individual tank, L; m to the nearest building on the same property; m to the property line]. Municipal bylaws may ask more.

roofTank._note: CSA B139.1.1:24 6.5.3 (p. 235): tanks supplying engines outside above the ground-level storey (a roof): at most 1,250 L each and 2,500 L in all on one supply line
